        'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR', 'DSLR', 'Mirrorless']
    }
    df = pd.DataFrame(data * 167)[:1000] # Approximate the size

    data=df_filtered,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    size='max_iso',
    sizes=(40, 500),  # Control the range of bubble sizes
    alpha=0.7,
    palette='viridis',
    ax=ax,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=0.5
)

ax.set_ylabel('Price (USD) - Log Scale', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate the legends for hue and size for clarity
hue_legend_index = len(df_filtered['sensor_type'].unique())
size_legend_index = len(handles) - hue_legend_index

legend1 = ax.legend(handles[:hue_legend_index], labels[:hue_legend_index],
                    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left',
                    title='Sensor Type', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
ax.add_artist(legend1)

legend2 = ax.legend(handles[hue_legend_index:], labels[hue_legend_index:],
                    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.6), loc='upper left',
                    title='Max ISO', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11',
                    labelspacing=1.2)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1])

# Save the figure
